subject: Urgent: Cardinal Payments checkout failures & latency spike
messages:
From: Oliver Holt <oliver.holt@cardinalpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@cardinalpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: URGENT: Checkout failures + tokenization latency spike

Kimberly,

We started seeing a surge in 5xx errors across our checkout endpoints at ~08:50 PT and end-users are reporting timeouts. Error rates spiked to ~8% and median token latency for the authorization step jumped from ~120ms to ~2.4s. This is directly impacting completion rates for card authorization — we see a 13% drop in successful checkouts in the last 20 minutes.

Attached is a screenshot of the merchant console and a small log bundle (backend-brief). Can you confirm this is on Redwood's side or if anything changed on our integration? We have a time-sensitive promotion running; this is high business impact. Please escalate.

Attachments: error_screenshot.png, backend-logs-20280311.zip

—Oliver
Oliver Holt
Head of Engineering, Cardinal Payments
oliver.holt@cardinalpay.com
+1 415-555-0117
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-03-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Checkout failures + tokenization latency spike

Thanks Oliver — I see the logs. Team: I'm standing up an exec warboard and coordinating a rapid response. Short plan: 1) confirm impact & blast radius, 2) identify recent deploys/config changes, 3) apply mitigation (rollback/patch) and validate, 4) communicate cadence to customer every 30m until resolved.

Jonas — please take technical lead. Marissa — please be our customer liaison (external comms, cadence). Laura — I may need an SLA exception decision and to loop in legal/sales if credits are requested.

Immediate asks for everyone:
- Marissa: confirm which Cardinal environments (prod/region) are impacted and share the most recent telemetry snapshot.
- Jonas: check for KV cache invalidations, model variant fallbacks, and kernel scheduling anomalies.
- Ops on-call: hold any non-critical deploys and prioritize this ticket (OPS-4921).

I'll create a calendar invite for a 30-minute warboard and invite the Cardinal leadership for a quick brief.

Thanks — KP

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Oliver Holt <oliver.holt@cardinalpay.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Checkout failures + tokenization latency spike

Kimberly / Marissa — quick triage notes from infra: we see a correlated spike in KV cache miss rates and a rebalancing event on the serving pool that started at 08:48 PT. Hypothesis: a partial rollout triggered a path that forces cold KV loads causing tokenization latencies to amplify under traffic.

Immediate remediation options (need quick decision):
- Option A (fast): pin affected customers to the previous stable model variant and force warm-up of KV caches (expected recovery ~15–25m).
- Option B (more invasive): roll back the rollout that triggered the change (20–45m with validation).

I am pushing an emergency patch to reduce synchronous KV reads in the tokenization path; I will publish the diff in 10m. If Marissa can confirm Cardinal's traffic is primarily in us-west-2 we can prioritize that pool.

Runbook ref: https://runbooks.redwood.com/kv-cache-rebalance (internal)
Jira: OPS-4921

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Manager, Inference Platform
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Holt <oliver.holt@cardinalpay.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.s@cardinalpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-12T01:15:00-07:00
Subject: [Redwood] Status update: Cardinal Payments — mitigation in progress

Oliver / Priya — quick update from the warboard: 
- Impact: confirmed production checkouts in us-west-2 only; spike began at 08:48 PT
- Action taken: Jonas pinned Cardinal to the stable model variant for us-west-2. We also pushed a targeted patch to reduce synchronous KV reads.
- ETA: we are seeing sign of recovery; error rate falling from 8% to ~1.2% over the last 30 minutes.

Next steps: we will continue to monitor for 2 hours, run a targeted warm-up sweep across the pool, and conduct a postmortem with Cardinal this week. We will provide an RCA and proposed compensatory credit if the drop in conversion exceeds 10% during the incident.

Log bundle for your records: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/cardinalpay/mitigation/patch-20280311.tar.gz

Please reply here if you need a 1:1 briefing; otherwise we'll keep this thread as the primary status channel.

Attachments: mitigation_patch.diff

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Executive Leadership <execs@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-13T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Executive readout: Cardinal Payments incident — brief and decision needed

Team — thank you for the rapid response. Short executive summary:
- Impact: Cardinal (key mid-market customer) experienced a production checkout failure window of ~25m starting 08:48 PT; conversion impact estimated between 10–14% during the window.
- Technical cause (preliminary): model variant rollout triggered a KV cache rebalance leading to synchronous cold loads in tokenization path.
- Mitigation: pinned to prior variant and pushed hotfix; customer saw error rate reduce to ~1% within 30–45m.

Decisions needed from Execs:
1) Approve a one-time goodwill credit proposal (three days of service credit pro-rated) pending final RCA.
2) Approve a retroactive halt to similar rollouts to the us-west-2 pool until additional safety checks are added.

Please reply with approvals or concerns. I recommend we authorize the credit and institute an immediate freeze on variant rollouts to the impacted pool until release gates are updated.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success & Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: [Redwood] Status update: Cardinal Payments — mitigation in progress

Thanks — confirming we see steady traffic and conversion recovered to expected baselines after the pin/patch. Appreciate the frequent updates and remediation. Two asks moving forward:
1) Full RCA and timeline for code/rollout gating changes (our ops team needs details for our postmortem).
2) Written confirmation on the service credit and how it will be applied to our account.

I'll coordinate a slot for a postmortem next week. Please include engineering leads and our product ops.
